page_title: BHA 1-0 AST | Brighton v Aston Villa 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van Hecke J. P. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+10' Brighton take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+10' Joao Pedro (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brighton.
90+9' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+8' The corner kick from Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

90+8' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee blows his whistle, Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
90+7' Joao Pedro (Brighton) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Valentin Barco (Brighton) comes onto the pitch for Simon Adingra.
90+3' A quickly taken corner by Brighton.
90+2' PENALTY APPEAL by Brighton, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
90+2' The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick. Joao Pedro (Brighton) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Ezri Konsa is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Calum Chambers (Aston Villa).
90' Substitution. Lucas Digne is replaced by Alex Moreno (Aston Villa).
90' Roberto De Zerbi (Brighton) gets a yellow card, off the field.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Carlos Baleba (Brighton) is coming onto the pitch as Billy Gilmour cannot continue after picking up an injury.
88' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Danny Welbeck and he is replaced by Jakub Moder (Brighton).
87' 1 - 0 Joao Pedro (Brighton) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the bottom right corner, and thus alter the score to 1:0.

87' Joao Pedro (Brighton) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom left corner. Robin Olsen anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
86' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
85' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) makes a slide tackle, but referee Robert Jones blows for a foul. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Brighton.
83' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
80' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. John McGinn (Aston Villa) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
79' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) will take the corner.

79' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Aston Villa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
78' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brighton.
77' Simon Adingra (Brighton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brighton.
73' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. Moussa Diaby will be replaced by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
72' The goal by Brighton is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
70' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Brighton players aren’t happy.
68' Goal! Igor provides Pascal Gross (Brighton) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
68' Julio Enciso (Brighton) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
63' This is a yellow card! Simon Adingra (Brighton) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.

62' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Joao Pedro (Brighton) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Robin Olsen pulls off a comfortable save.
61' Today's match ends for Facundo Buonanotte who will be replaced by Julio Enciso (Brighton).
61' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

61' Simon Adingra (Brighton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Brighton will have a corner.
57' The ball rebounded to Matty Cash (Aston Villa), whose first-time shot from long range had the keeper scrambling but flew just wide of the right post.
57' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
56' The ball is cleared after Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Robert Jones blows his whistle as Billy Gilmour (Brighton) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
49' Pascal Gross (Brighton) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
47' Pascal Gross (Brighton) delivers a fine ball into the box from a free kick. However, the opposition's defence make sure none of his teammates get a challenge in on the goalkeeper.
47' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) touches the ball with his hand. A free kick to Brighton.
46' The whistle blows and Robert Jones starts the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

45+5' What a sweet touch by Pascal Gross (Brighton) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Robin Olsen to hold. Brighton force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+3' CHANCE! Simon Adingra (Brighton) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a low shot to the bottom left corner, but Robin Olsen produces an excellent save.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
44' Robin Olsen (Aston Villa) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
44' Robin Olsen (Aston Villa) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
43' Simon Adingra (Brighton) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
43' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Simon Adingra, but Robin Olsen displays great awareness to stop him.
40' Great teamplay by Aston Villa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
34' Joel Veltman (Brighton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
26' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is substituted due to injury. Unai Emery gives a chance to Matty Cash.
23' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) picks up an injury.
20' Robert Jones blows his whistle and it's Simon Adingra (Brighton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
12' Adam Webster (Brighton) watches the corner all the way, but places his header just over the bar from close range.
11' There's an opportunity for Pascal Gross (Brighton) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
11' Joao Pedro (Brighton) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Brighton manage to earn a corner.
9' The corner from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is intercepted by the defence.
9' The referee points to the corner flag and Brighton will take a corner. Billy Gilmour (Brighton) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

6' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Bart Verbruggen anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Aston Villa will have the kick-off.
Robert Jones will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
